designs.name: 白色仪器台
designs.detail: Direction 01: restrained precision instrument console. Off-white canvas, graphite typography, thin grey dividers, one calm teal accent, compact rectangular controls and excellent whitespace. Layout: slender vertical project navigation, broad central observation workspace, narrow contextual inspector. Header "反应动力学研究" with tabs "设计" "运行" "笔记" "比较", active "运行". Main dominant UV–Vis chart titled "实时光谱", x "Wavelength (nm)" 300 to 700, y "Absorbance (AU)" 0 to 1.2, three clearly distinct measured curves at 0, 5, 10 min. Beneath it a short horizontal experiment timeline with "投料" "混合" "测量" "终检"; the current measurement is selected. Inspector has selected sample "Sample A", "温度 298 K", "模拟时间 10 min", action button "记录观察", clear distinction "模型假设" vs "环境观测". Toolbar "暂停" and "导出". Refined technical clarity, not a generic finance dashboard. A small permanent corner label "01 / Instrument Console".

designs.name: 暗色运行观测站
designs.focus: 长程 Agent 运行监控
designs.detail: Direction 02: dark scientific operations observatory. Deep graphite background, warm white labels, restrained cyan for observations, amber for warnings, coral for failed actions. High contrast with flat opaque panels, no glowing neon. Layout is a command center without a permanent left sidebar: thin global top navigation, three horizontal run lanes occupying center, large aligned time axis; rightmost compact live event feed. Header "运行观测站". Each lane shows a model-run label "Run A", "Run B", "Run C", action blocks "准备" "加热" "采样" "测量", one warning event with "测量失败", and compact meaningful temperature traces on aligned x-axis "模拟时间 (min)" and y-axis "T (K)". Bottom analytical strip shows selected run's spectrum with axis "Wavelength (nm)" / "Absorbance (AU)" and an activity log. Separate resource indicators "工具调用 18 / 40" "Token 12k / 60k" and separate "墙钟 02:14" from "模拟时间 12 min". Visible "停止后续调用", "查看笔记", "导出记录". This should feel like a refined mission console for sustained experiments, not cyberpunk. Corner label "02 / Live Observatory".

designs.name: 研究记录本
designs.focus: 假设、证据与版本化记录
designs.detail: Direction 03: notebook-first editorial scientific workspace. Warm ivory paper color, deep ink text, muted olive accents; refined serif experiment title and highly legible sans-serif controls, occasional monospace event references. Flat web interface, not a photo of a physical notebook. Layout: narrow outline of research questions on left, a large beautifully typeset central notebook page, slim evidence margin on right. Title "温度如何影响结晶？". Visible document sections "研究问题", "模型假设", "证据与修订", "下一步实验"; concise realistic one-line text: "假设：缓慢冷却可能改善晶体生长。" and "状态：尚待检验". Inline chart plotting "Temperature (K)" against "Time (min)" and evidence link chip "测量 06". Right evidence margin contains actual-looking small instrument trace and tags "环境观测", "模型记录", "人工批注" with visually separate colors. Version control at top "版本 3" and "查看差异"; a small revision card shows "假设更新" with one added green line and one removed red line. Clear toolbar "运行实验" "插入证据" "导出". No fake long paragraphs or private reasoning. Corner label "03 / Research Notebook".

designs.name: 实验编排画布
designs.detail: Direction 04: canvas-first experiment composition application. Very light cool grey dotted grid, crisp white component nodes, graphite connectors, indigo selection accent, distinct small inlet/outlet dots. Layout is an expansive center graph with compact floating toolbar, collapsible component library on left and parameter inspector on right. Header "实验编排" and segmented tabs "设计" "运行预览". Clear logical directed graph across center: "原料 A" and "溶剂" flow into "混合釜", then "加热器", then a "取样" node branches to "UV–Vis" and "留样"; arrows connect actual ports and never cross labels. Each node has small realistic equipment icon and a short parameter like "298 K" or "5 mL". Selected UV–Vis node opens inspector with "波长范围 300–700 nm" and preview spectrum with meaningful axes. Bottom ribbon "样品流转" shows sample ancestry A → A1 → A1-测量 with distinct sample chips. Primary "校验设计" and "保存并运行" buttons, explicit status "设计草稿". Practical node editor, not an abstract mind map. Corner label "04 / Experiment Canvas".

designs.name: 空间实验室
designs.detail: Direction 05: spatial laboratory workspace with a useful 3D overview embedded INSIDE a flat functional website. Soft pale stone UI, graphite text, muted sea-green selection, beautiful restrained isometric 3D apparatus with ceramic white bases and transparent glass. Layout: broad central viewport occupies about half the screen, right measurement panel occupies a third, bottom action timeline. Top title "实验室总览", toggle "空间" "数据" with "空间" selected. Viewport shows only a coherent tabletop assembly: source reservoir → stirred glass vessel on heater → sample vial → compact spectrometer, with thin labeled connections. Apparatus view explicitly tagged "示意视图"; no humans, no magical molecules, no fantasy laboratory. Selected spectrometer has a subtle outline and a readable label "UV–Vis". Right panel is a serious 2D chart "吸收光谱" with x "Wavelength (nm)" and y "Absorbance (AU)", selected sample "A1", recorded temperature "298 K", and "查看原始数据". Bottom shows four operation events and a progress playhead with separate simulated and elapsed time. Global actions "添加操作", "暂停", "研究笔记". Spatial view is supporting illustration, never evidence. Corner label "05 / Spatial Laboratory".

designs.name: 模型对照台
designs.focus: 相同条件下比较过程与成本
designs.detail: Direction 06: matched-condition model comparison workspace, editorial analytical style. White and pale slate surfaces, strong black typography, three consistent categorical colors teal / violet / ochre; no leaderboard trophy aesthetics. No conventional left sidebar. Header "模型对照" with compact study navigation. Top horizontal locked-condition strip reads "同一设计" "Seed 42" "操作上限 40" "相同观测接口"; these are selected comparison controls, not marketing claims. Main center split into three equal aligned columns headed "Model A", "Model B", "Model C"; each column shows a matching mini spectrum and action timeline on shared scales. Model B has a visible failed measurement event and its missing final result is "—". Bottom comparative table rows "终检状态", "有效操作", "失败操作", "Token", "墙钟时间", with status "完成", "中断", "完成"; illustrative values only, no winner. Include a large overlaid chart "测量轨迹" with x "模拟时间 (min)" and y "Temperature (K)", legend matching the three columns, and line style differences so meaning does not depend on color alone. Action buttons "复制条件" "查看差异" "导出完整记录". Corner label "06 / Matched Comparison".

designs.detail: Direction 09: welcoming but expert guided experiment setup with live preview. Soft white background, spacious typography, deep forest-green primary controls, light neutral borders, restrained rounded corners. Layout: thin top navigation and numbered step rail across top "1 研究问题" "2 实验设计" "3 执行方式" "4 检查并运行"; active step 3. Large central two-column form-and-preview, no dashboard card grid. Title "让模型开始一项实验". Left form has execution segmented control "手动" "离线 Agent" "模型 Agent", selected third. Provider select "OpenAI" and model field "选择模型"; next short provider chips "DeepSeek" "Qwen" as alternatives, no compatibility claims. A clearly empty password field labelled "临时 API key", helper "仅用于本次运行，不写入导出", no credential characters. Budget controls "工具调用上限 40" "运行时限 10 min". Right panel "实验预览" shows simple connected components with a miniature axis-labeled spectrum example, initial state "298 K", seed "42", instruments "UV–Vis", a brief run checklist and link "查看设计". Primary bottom action "检查并运行", secondary "保存草稿". Show exact understated badge "模型连接待验证". Balanced useful onboarding design for researchers. Corner label "09 / Experiment Launchpad".
designs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity desktop web interface design for ChemWorld Research Workbench, for scientific researchers and AI Agent developers. A flat straight-on full-screen screenshot, wide 16:10 landscape, high resolution, edge-to-edge UI, no laptop frame, no perspective, no surrounding moodboard. This is a distinct product design exploration, practical and implementable. Strong typography, clear hierarchy, disciplined spacing, polished visualization. Use readable Simplified Chinese headings with English scientific labels where helpful. Short labels and sparse concise body text, avoid illegible microtext.
Brand text exactly "ChemWorld". Visible badge exactly "概念设计 · 演示数据". All plotted values and experiment records are illustrative mock data. Do not claim actual model performance. Do not show passwords or API key strings. Environment observations, model-authored hypotheses, and human notes must be distinguished if present; never label private reasoning or chain of thought. Scientific charts have meaningful axis labels and units, readable ticks and legends. Missing results use em dash, never zero. No huge KPI cards crowding out research content. No stock photos, decorative molecular backgrounds, floating holograms, marketing jargon, or watermarks. One coherent complete UI, not a collage of alternative screens.

designs.focus: 社区入口、成果展示与可复现浏览
designs.detail: Direction 10: publication-quality public research project portal that leads into a real experiment workbench. Airy off-white page, ink-black oversized editorial typography, restrained cobalt accent, strict grid, subtle horizontal rules. Flat full desktop website screenshot, top navigation "ChemWorld" "探索实验" "工作台" "文档". Main title "看见实验如何发生" and a short supporting line "从研究问题，到证据与复现。" Main visual is a large beautifully designed interactive experiment story, not generic stock hero art: left 30 percent contains three numbered stages "01 提出假设" "02 运行实验" "03 检查证据", right 70 percent contains a spectrum with x "Wavelength (nm)" and y "Absorbance (AU)" above a timeline of actual-looking actions and linked authored note. It should look like an accessible narrative visualization embedded in a research website. Below, a compact row of three research example tiles "反应动力学" "结晶探索" "连续流", each with its own relevant miniature chart or apparatus diagram. Buttons "打开示例实验" and "创建我的实验", with unobtrusive "无需密钥浏览示例". Include a concise reproducibility strip "实验条件" "完整记录" "导出与回放". Display demo status clearly; no fabricated publication counts, testimonials, claims of accuracy, model rankings, or deployment claims. Corner label "10 / Research Showcase".
